نشتك (form VIII)
# نَشْتَكِ (naštaki) /naʃ.ta.ki/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
# نُشْتَكَ (nuštaka) /nuʃ.ta.ka/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
